title: Auto-research loop under the dense-frontier rules: dynamic token dropping is worth about 2x, steady from 495 to 3,975 PF; nothing pushes it further
result: Rules (Prasann 11-17/18): dense full fine-tune is the reference, LoRA and fixed re-mixes count as the dense baseline, a method counts only at the deepest dense loss, cheaper arms get proportionally more steps. Measure: budget-matched runs with complete LR schedules on a 4-task 4k-16k pool (Qwen3.5-4B; pools of 7,808 / 31,232 / 124,928 rows), final dense-forward answer CE on 320 held-out 16k rows (eval_size below 500), FLOPs-to-match against the Pareto frontier of dense full fine-tune and dense LoRA at every budget up to 7,934 PF. Result: whole-model LoRA + online router keeping 50% / 20% / 7% of document tokens after blocks 7 / 16 / 24 (0.29x dense per step) is 2.3x at 495 PF (0.134), 2.2x at 991 PF (0.100), 2.4x at 1,980 PF (0.074; two seeds each) and 1.9x at 3,973 PF (0.065, one seed); against dense full fine-tune alone 2.7-2.9x. The old 20% / 7% recipe fades with data (2.1x at 991 PF, 1.2x at 3,957 PF): best arm on outlier, worst on reorder, and reorder is 60-70% of the loss. Generation evals (one seed, F1, eval_size 500 per cell, 3 tasks, reorder grader broken) confirm it: 16k mean 0.942 for the drop arm at 1,980 PF against 0.851 for dense LoRA at equal FLOPs and 0.929 / 0.938 for dense full fine-tune / dense LoRA at about twice the FLOPs. At 64k rows (144 held-out rows) the ratio against dense LoRA is 1.6-2.0x: no growth with length. Closed: keep schedules (within one-epoch noise; 1.6x budget-matched), gradient compensation, mixture-of-depths, adaptive keep by gradient mass, first cut at block 3, more or deeper stages, 10% / 3% budgets, frozen early blocks, sparse backward (which showed the loss gap is the missing gradient of dropped tokens, not the truncated context), backward skipping on easy rows. Small-budget only: document drop on 16k rows (2.7-2.9x at <= 991 PF, level at 1,971 PF) and per-task keep budgets (2.6x at 991 PF, gone at 1,984 PF). Far from the 10-20x target; the cost floor is blocks 0-6, which must run on and be trained through every token.
